enunciado: Write the functions square(x), max3(a, b, c) and rectangleArea(b, h) and use them to show square(9), max3(4, 11, 7) and rectangleArea(2.5, 4.0).
objetivos: Declare functions with a return type and parameters
pistas: The first word of the declaration is the type of the returned value.
return ends the function and hands back the value.
max3 can rely on a max2 function.
